title: [Market of Lost Things, Hold]
description: The vessel's cargo braces have been converted into permanent booth partitions, creating compact vendor alcoves arranged around a central tent area.  Low ceilings and uneven flooring make movement cramped, but clever carpentry has added trap storage compartments underfoot.  Warped wicker baskets brimming with ripened fruits and bins of exotic spices fill the air with an intoxicating scent.
